population_rule: Every pinned episode, provider attempt and author elaboration artifact for the 31 frozen states. Count each original target once per cohort, then show episode, invocation stage and diagnostic denominators separately.
line_rule: Bind each diagnostic to the matching author command filename and byte-identical materialized Lean source archive member. Retain raw compiler coordinates. A lexical source token on the reported line is required for missing-name nominations. The surrounding theorem/lemma is lexical attribution and does not reconstruct elaboration scope.
name_rule: Missing-name categories require explicit compiler Unknown constant, identifier or namespace text. Use lexical module/declaration/binder evidence for project-shaped names. A fixed whitelist marks qualified library-shaped candidates for follow-up only. Ambiguous unqualified names remain origin unknown. Unknown tactic, projections, syntax/notation, failed type/instance inference, goals and resources are distinct categories.
prior_negatives_rule: Attach a separate earlier exact-original-import probe receipt for any matched state/name. Separate same and changed import lists. Equality of imports does not equate namespaces, opened declarations or hypotheses. Exact-original-import rejection never proves global library absence.
correction_rule: Candidate log command and diagnostic filename must each agree with paired source basename. Diagnostic archives are observed runs, including cascading/repeated errors and timeouts. No inference that a name was the first cause, globally exists, is repairable with an import, or is a performance win.
